name: proofwall
description: Self-hosted testimonial collector and Wall of Love for Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the founder dashboard. Use a long, unique passphrase.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random string used to sign session cookies. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

POWERED_BY_URL.description: Optional. Where the "Powered by ProofWall" badge links. Leave empty to link to this deployment.
